title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Basic Technology - Materials & Processing
subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: The property of a metal that allows it to be drawn into wires without breaking is called:
questions.explain: Ductility is the ability of a material to stretch into a wire. Malleability is the ability to be hammered into sheets.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which of these ceramics is typically used for electrical insulators?
questions.explain: Porcelain is widely used for high-voltage electrical insulators because of its high resistance to electricity.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: The term 'Thermoplastic' implies that the material becomes soft when:
questions.explain: Thermoplastics soften when heated and harden when cooled, allowing them to be reshaped multiple times.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Galvanized iron sheets are coated with which metal to prevent rusting?
questions.explain: Galvanization is the process of applying a protective zinc coating to steel or iron to prevent rusting.
questions.subject: Basic Technology
